description: For each Support row, whether its origin is still connected to its source (or, for a row without one, to at least one key destination) over the open edges, regardless of travel time. Edges that cannot close are part of the graph and always open. One binding per source (where source = ...) gives one system layer per source; a binding where source is null gives the any-source layer.
